verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a full REST API reference covering metrics, logs, and traces (datadog-docs-24, datadog-docs-23, datadog-docs-13) plus an official MCP server explicitly designed to let external AI agents query Datadog data (datadog-docs-3, datadog-probe-3), directly matching the story of an external agent debugging production via documented APIs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of an agent successfully using the MCP server/API for real debugging, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable at expected paths (datadog-probe-2), slightly weakening machine-readable API discoverability.
